attack_mechanism: When the debug register-access command selects architectural R4, the register-file read value is routed through `dbg_reg_din` and the debug memory/output muxes. An adversary with debug-port or internal-probe access can sample `openMSP430.dbg_mem_dout` while the R4 read command is active. `openMSP430.dbg_mem_dout` is a selected stage of that readback chain; the state and data choices on this path depend on `openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_reg_rd`, `openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_rst`, `openMSP430.dbg_0.mem_data_wr`, `openMSP430.dbg_0.mem_bw`. The sampled word reveals the complete R4 contents, rather than only a predicate or indirect effect of the register value. The causal signal chain is `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.r4 -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.reg_dest -> openMSP430.dbg_0.mem_data -> openMSP430.dbg_mem_dout`.

When the debug register-access command selects architectural R4, the register-file read value is routed through `dbg_reg_din` and the debug memory/output muxes. An adversary with debug-port or internal-probe access can sample `openMSP430.dbg_reg_din` while the R4 read command is active. `openMSP430.dbg_reg_din` is a selected stage of that readback chain; the route is implemented by the corresponding combinational or registered assignment. The sampled word reveals the complete R4 contents, rather than only a predicate or indirect effect of the register value. The causal signal chain is `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.r4 -> openMSP430.dbg_reg_din`.

When the instruction decoder selects R4 as `reg_src` or `reg_dest`, the execution unit presents its value to the ALU operand network. An internal probe of `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.op_dst_in` during a chosen MOV, logical, add, or shift operation reveals R4 directly or as a known reversible function. `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.op_dst_in` is an operand, result, or status-producing intermediate reached while the state and data choices on this path depend on `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.dbg_halt_st`, `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.dst_inst_sext_sel`, `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.dst_mdb_in_bw_sel`, `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.dst_reg_dest_sel`. The observation bypasses direct protection of R4; even a one-bit flag leaks a predicate that can be accumulated over chosen operations. The causal signal chain is `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.r4 -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.reg_dest -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.op_dst_in`.

When the instruction decoder selects R4 as `reg_src` or `reg_dest`, the execution unit presents its value to the ALU operand network. An internal probe of `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.op_dst` during a chosen MOV, logical, add, or shift operation reveals R4 directly or as a known reversible function. `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.op_dst` is an operand, result, or status-producing intermediate reached while the state and data choices on this path depend on `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.dbg_halt_st`, `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.dst_inst_sext_sel`, `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.dst_mdb_in_bw_sel`, `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.dst_reg_dest_sel`. The observation bypasses direct protection of R4; even a one-bit flag leaks a predicate that can be accumulated over chosen operations. The causal signal chain is `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.r4 -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.reg_dest -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.op_dst`.

An instruction that uses R4 as a source operand, store datum, or address base transfers its contents from the register file into the memory address/data backbone. Probing `openMSP430.mem_backbone_0.pmem_din` during that transaction exposes R4 directly for a move/store or reveals a deterministic address/data function of R4. `openMSP430.mem_backbone_0.pmem_din` carries the resulting address, data word, or bus-selected derivative when the state and data choices on this path depend on `openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_reg_rd`, `openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_rst`, `openMSP430.dbg_0.mem_data_wr`, `openMSP430.dbg_0.mem_bw`, and the remaining path guards. The observation discloses all or part of the confidential R4 value and repeated chosen instructions can resolve otherwise masked bits. The causal signal chain is `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.r4 -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.reg_dest -> openMSP430.dbg_0.mem_data -> openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_mem_dout -> openMSP430.mem_backbone_0.pmem_din`.
